name: Kiesub Electronics
about:
Kiesub Electronics was founded in 1973 in Las Vegas, Nevada, and has operated continuously from the same industrial center near the Strip. The company began as a wholesale electronics distributor serving the local market and has since expanded its footprint to an 11,000‑square‑foot facility that combines a walk‑in retail store with a manufacturing operation.

Today Kiesub functions as both a broad‑line distributor and a contract manufacturer. The distribution side stocks more than 75,000 electronic parts, components, and accessories, including one of the Southwest’s largest battery inventories. The contract manufacturing division, launched in 1995, produces custom cables, wire harnesses, printed circuit boards, and LED illumination products such as edge‑lit panels and signage for casinos, hotels, and entertainment venues. As a member of the Genie Group purchasing cooperative, Kiesub leverages the buying power of over 90 distributors and 300 locations to source from more than 300 manufacturer accounts.

The customer base spans gaming, entertainment, and hospitality businesses, as well as manufacturers, repair shops, low‑voltage contractors, utilities, school districts, universities, government agencies, and military installations. Hobbyists and walk‑in consumers are also served through the retail counter.

Kiesub emphasizes in‑house design and manufacturing to control quality, and it offers same‑day shipping on in‑stock orders placed before noon Pacific time. The company cites its experienced staff—many with 25‑plus years in the industry—and its Genie Group affiliation as key differentiators.
